newsitem.title: YEMEN: At least two injured in Yemen demonstration.
newsitem.headline: At least two injured in Yemen demonstration.

text.p: Yemeni security forces fired into the air and used tear gas on demonstrators protesting in the city of Mukalla against poor services, and at least two people were injured, residents and an official said.
"One soldier from the security forces has been injured during a demonstration in Mukalla," a security official told Reuters.
"Demonstrators..started attacking the security forces who were monitoring and injured the soldier. The security forces had to use tear gas to disperse them. The situation is normal now."
He estimated the protesters numbered about 500.

Residents in Mukalla, about 780 km (470 miles) east of the capital Sanaa, told Reuters by telephone that one civilian was injured when forces used gas and fired in the air to disperse the protest against water and power shortages.
Yemen raised electricity and water rates this year as part of the impoverished country's economic reform programme.

Unlike its wealthier Gulf Arab neighbours, Yemen has no desalination plants to turn sea water into drinking water and its rugged mountain terrain makes it difficult for some regions to receive services.
